summary: A gi-specific single-leg-X companion that distinguishes the course’s entry choices, fabric-grip sweeps and responses to passing.
description: Use Single Leg X Reimagined to locate a gi entry or sweeping problem and distinguish it from general X-guard study.
overview: The syllabus starts with several routes into the position and later separates sweeps, stand-up options and counters. Sleeve and lapel labels are a useful sign that some examples depend on gi connections.

guide.display_title: Adam Wardzinski: Single Leg X in the Gi

fits: You already have a butterfly, shin-to-shin or De La Riva interest and want to find its single-leg-X entry in a gi syllabus.
consider_alternative_if: For a broader X-guard entry and sweep collection, compare The Marcelo X Guard.

includes: Butterfly, shin-to-shin and De La Riva entries; sleeve/lapel sweep variations.
Stand-up options, back takes, submissions and counters to pulling or passing.
limits: This is presented as a gi course; the fabric-grip sections are not a no-gi entry curriculum.

start_here.title: Match an entry to a grip-dependent follow-up
start_here.task: In volume 1, find the entry from the guard you currently study. Then compare volume 2’s far-sleeve and lapel headings with the other sweep labels. Mark which lessons explicitly require clothing grips so you do not mistake them for interchangeable no-gi examples.

sources.title: Single Leg X Reimagined by Adam Wardzinski
sources.note: Verified gi focus, entry families, sleeve/lapel sweep sections, stand-up and counter material. Listing inspected; course video content not reviewed.

sources.title: The Marcelo X Guard by Marcelo Garcia
sources.note: Verified butterfly/shin-to-shin entries, sleeve/collar examples, stand-up finishes and pummel/backstep counters. Listing inspected; course video content not reviewed.
